question: Which CRISPRi system was used to repress competing pathways in S. marcescens?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%CRISPRi%' OR text ILIKE '%interference%' OR text ILIKE '%dCas%' OR text ILIKE '%dead Cas%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, statement, printed_text FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%CRISPR%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%CRISPR%' OR statement ILIKE '%interference%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%dCas%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%CRISPR%' OR text ILIKE '%interference%' OR text ILIKE '%dCas%'
SELECT id, figure_id, statement, printed_text FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%CRISPR%' OR array_to_string(printed_text, ' ') ILIKE '%CRISPR%' OR statement ILIKE '%interfer%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%CRISPR%' ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%repress%' OR text ILIKE '%knockdown%' OR text ILIKE '%knock-down%' OR text ILIKE '%silenc%' OR text ILIKE '%CRISPRa%' OR text ILIKE '%sgRNA%' OR text ILIKE '%guide RNA%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (8) ORDER BY line_no
